newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Bomb explodes outside Serbian court building.
newsitem.headline: Bomb explodes outside Serbian court building.

text.p: A bomb exploded in front of a court building in the northeastern Serbian city of Novi Sad during the night, the Belgrade-based independent news agency BETA reported on Tuesday.
No one was injured in the explosion but there was considerable damage to the building when the bomb exploded on a staircase in front of the main entrance to the court, it said.
The President of Novi Sad District Court, Zikica Dronjak, said an investigation was underway, and postponed court business on Tuesday for security reasons.
BETA said two trials which had attracted "great public interest" had been due to take place at the court building on Tuesday.
The trial of Dragoslav Bokan, a Belgrade film director and former commander of the White Eagles paramilitary organization, on charges of armed robbery, was due to resume.
The trial of Borislav Colic, accused of the murders of a Novi Sad businessman, his pregnant wife and their four-year old son, had been scheduled to begin.
